set.body:
Problem: existing dataset tests are useful for low-level selection, latent decoding, and LNA archive lookup, but they do not yet prove the target workflow: multi-subject, multi-session, multi-run access with validated shape/frame/event semantics.

Work: add compact fixtures that exercise subject/session/run enumeration, typed query resolution, per-run shape/TR validation, event-table alignment, masked latent defaults, and downstream FmriDataset/FmriSeries views. Use R ecosystem parity fixtures where behavior must match fmridataset/fmrireg/neuroim2.

Acceptance: shared tests cover the platform-independent hierarchy and selection contracts; JVM tests cover real LNA/file adapter behavior; datasetJVM/test and datasetJS/test are green; failures point to DatasetError-style ADTs rather than raw exceptions.
set.title: Dataset: add end-to-end multi-subject session run fixtures
